designationHistory.name: Big Levels Game Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt set aside the Big Levels Game Refuge as a game sanctuary and refuge in the George Washington National Forest, Virginia.

authority.citation: Proclamation 2128, July 6, 1935, 49 Stat. 3448 (under Act of Aug. 11, 1916, 39 Stat. 446, 476)
